item.kizuna_agent.pointer.tooltip.mark: Right-click a block: mark it for the assistant
item.kizuna_agent.pointer.tooltip.far: Right-click far away: mark the block under the crosshair; aiming at the sky marks your feet
item.kizuna_agent.pointer.tooltip.use: Then just /agent, e.g. "build a wall between 1 and 2"
kizuna_agent.pointer.full: All %s marks are used; sneak + right-click to clear them first
kizuna_agent.pointer.unavailable: The pointer staff only works in a single-player world
